name: OmaGTD
author: Enrico Cambiaso
description: Getting Things Done for Omarchy, modelled on OmniFocus. A bar pill that shows the inbox and the next actions, a keyboard-driven panel over what is due today, a fullscreen view for the full five-step GTD workflow — clarify, organize, reflect, engage — and a sqlite3 database underneath. Projects/areas, contexts as tags, waiting, someday/maybe, recurring actions, defer/due forecasting, an internal calendar, and OmniFocus-style review counters. Ships a `gtd` CLI so every step is scriptable and bindable to a hotkey.

barWidget.description: Inbox and next-action counts in the bar; the panel is what is due today.
